description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply & Higher Educations - Order to acquire the lands in Minuwangoda, Attanagalla and Gampaha,  D/S Division's Gampaha District for Gampaha Waste Water Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for water supply infrastructure projects, including boundary descriptions, locations, and claimant information. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses on land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
